data: Synthetic calibration content hashes and logits only; no cohort rows, model weights, Index or held-out data
seed: Fixed synthetic numeric counterexamples; ordinary parity tests use their own local seed where specified
scope: Feature-temperature identity hashes full floating-point weights; default weights match custom 0<t_min<1; identity status uses a 1e-12 numerical tolerance for actual constant-one temperature, not bitwise equality. Serving and training reject nonfinite or nonpositive derived temperatures. Invalid D temperatures fail with fixed calibration_temperature_invalid error and no answers. Existing fitted-metadata proof semantics are unchanged. No learned-capability or model-quality claim.
